## Personality

Gideon Duckett is known for an exemplary character, having previously been described as pleasant and cheerful. However, he has also been compelled to act in a disagreeable manner.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P14](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0014), [v3 ch.Evening P15](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000)_

## History

Gideon Duckett owned an excellent farm and maintained an exemplary character as a youth. He developed a secret romance with Isolde, which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discovered when she stumbled upon the couple sharing an intimate moment in a garden shortly before Isolde confided their engagement. After marrying Isolde at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill), Gideon became a father when they welcomed a young daughter, [Small Nell Lucinda](../character/small-nell-lucinda.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015), [v3 ch.Evening P15](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0015), [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), +7 more_

### [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gideon-duckett--isolde-pembroke.md)

Gideon is engaged to [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), with whom he shares a romantic relationship.
